A [[Gender/Legends|male]] '''individual''' served [[Prince-Admiral/Legends|Prince-Admiral]] [[Delak Krennel]] in the naval forces of the [[Ciutric Hegemony]] as a [[Captain/Legends|captain]] of the [[Victory-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Victory''-class Star Destroyer]] [[Aspiration (Victory-class)|''Aspiration'']]. After the [[Battle of Distna]], his ship was sent to check the site of the battle for any survivors. There, he noticed a Star Destroyer, but did not detain it, believing it to be one of Krennel's ships.
